verdict.rationale: Fedora docs claim up-to-date packages/tools/runtimes and container tooling from Red Hat ecosystem, supporting a general 'latest software' story, but there is no specific evidence about AI/ML software availability, latest IDE support, or toolchain currency, and community comments focus on desktop/DE issues rather than dev tooling. missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI/ML framework support, IDE availability/updates, toolchain version currency, and independent corroboration of developer workflow claims.
